review_policy: These pages are monitored in five independent subject sweeps. Automation may flag new language or changed deadlines, but a person must confirm all public funding claims before publication.

required_sweeps.label: Economic development
required_sweeps.query_intent: Non-loan business, entrepreneurship, workforce, community development, rural development, and technical-assistance funding

required_sweeps.label: Education
required_sweeps.query_intent: Scholarships, student awards, training stipends, classroom grants, and education-program support

required_sweeps.label: Healthcare
required_sweeps.query_intent: Community health grants, healthcare scholarships, wellness support, sponsorships, and health-access funding

required_sweeps.label: Nonprofits
required_sweeps.query_intent: Program, operating, capital, capacity-building, event, and fiscally sponsored nonprofit support

required_sweeps.label: Arts & culture
required_sweeps.query_intent: Arts grants, artist awards, artwork purchases, fellowships, cultural programs, and creative-economy support
